description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Current Suzuki OEM Seat Belt for the Suzuki Samurai.
It does away with the unreliable retractor mechanism and replaces it with manually adjusted Seat Belts.
This conversion kit comes with the Drivers Side and Passengers Side Seat Belts and Plates to cover the holes left by the removal of the old seat belt retractor mechanism.
Just remove your existing Seat Belts and place the New plate back on the retractor housing. Then just bolt the new Seat Belts into the existing holes.
Yes, it uses the existing holes because this Seat Belt is made for the Suzuki SJ413.
NOTE: Both male and female pieces will need to be used as the insert width is wider than original OEM.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Seatbelt Portion with Female Latch (Driver Side)
Qty 1 – Seatbelt Portion with Male Latch (Driver Side)
Qty 1 – Seatbelt Portion with Female Latch (Passenger Side)
Qty 1 – Seatbelt Portion with Male Latch (Passenger Side)
Qty 2 – Plate, Retractor Mechanism
Qty 8 – Screws, Plate, Retractor Mechanism
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
